scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.funding: Full tuition, monthly stipend, return flights, visa costs
scholarships.cycle: Applications open August and close in October/November for the following September
scholarships.summary: One-year master's degree anywhere in the UK, awarded on leadership potential rather than grades alone. Requires two years of work experience and an unconditional offer from a UK university.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
scholarships.funding: Full tuition, stipend, airfare and thesis grant
scholarships.cycle: Nominations usually open September and close in October/December
scholarships.summary: For citizens of low and middle income Commonwealth countries who could not otherwise afford UK study. You apply through a nominated national agency or university, so check your country's route first.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
scholarships.fields: Six development themes, including health, technology and resilience
scholarships.funding: Full tuition, stipend, airfare and fieldwork allowance
scholarships.cycle: Applications usually open September and close in December
scholarships.summary: Three years of doctoral study at a UK university in a subject that supports development in your home country. A strong, specific research proposal matters more than a long CV.

scholarships.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
scholarships.funding: Full cost of study plus a maintenance allowance and family allowances
scholarships.cycle: Apply with your Cambridge course application; most deadlines fall between October and early January
scholarships.summary: Full-time postgraduate study at Cambridge for applicants from outside the UK, selected for academic excellence, leadership and a commitment to improving the lives of others.

scholarships.name: Rhodes Scholarship
scholarships.funding: Full tuition, stipend and travel to Oxford
scholarships.cycle: Country-specific rounds usually open in June and close between August and October
scholarships.summary: Postgraduate study at the University of Oxford, applied for through your country or regional constituency. Selection weighs character, leadership and service as heavily as academic record.

scholarships.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
scholarships.funding: Tuition, living stipend, airfare and health insurance
scholarships.cycle: Apply through your local US embassy or Fulbright commission; deadlines vary by country
scholarships.summary: Graduate study or research in the United States for citizens of more than 160 countries. Most candidates apply a full year before their intended start date.

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
scholarships.funding: Full tuition, travel and installation costs, plus a monthly living allowance
scholarships.cycle: Programme deadlines usually fall between December and January
scholarships.summary: A single master's degree taught across two or more European universities. You apply directly to each joint programme, so shortlist by subject before checking entry requirements.

scholarships.name: DAAD EPOS Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
scholarships.fields: Engineering, planning, public health, agriculture, economics
scholarships.funding: Full tuition, monthly stipend, insurance and travel allowance
scholarships.cycle: Most courses accept applications between August and October for the following year
scholarships.summary: For graduates with at least two years of professional experience from developing countries, studying a practice-oriented master's in Germany. Applications go to each course, not to DAAD centrally.

scholarships.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship
scholarships.funding: Full tuition plus a monthly allowance and travel
scholarships.cycle: Embassy recommendation rounds usually open in April and close in June
scholarships.summary: Study at a Japanese university with a preparatory Japanese language year where needed. Applications are screened by your local Japanese embassy, including a written test and interview.

scholarships.name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
scholarships.fields: Science, engineering, computing and biomedical sciences
scholarships.funding: Full tuition, monthly stipend, settling-in and airfare allowance
scholarships.cycle: Two intakes a year, with applications open roughly January and June
scholarships.summary: A direct route to a fully funded PhD in Singapore, chosen by research area and supervisor rather than by a single department. You submit one application that is considered by all four partner institutions.

scholarships.name: Mandela Rhodes Scholarship
scholarships.funding: Tuition, accommodation, meals, study materials and medical aid
scholarships.cycle: Applications usually open mid-March and close in April
scholarships.summary: Postgraduate study in South Africa for young Africans, combined with a compulsory leadership development programme. Selection looks for reconciliation, education, entrepreneurship and leadership potential.

scholarships.name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
scholarships.fields: Any field offered by a partner university
scholarships.funding: Full tuition, accommodation, books, stipend and leadership support
scholarships.cycle: Each partner university runs its own round, typically between November and February
scholarships.summary: For academically talented young Africans facing financial barriers. Beyond fees, the programme funds mentoring, leadership training and transition to work or further study. Apply to a partner university and its Scholars Program together.

scholarships.name: Michael Taiwo (MT) Scholarships
scholarships.funding: About USD 1,000 per scholar: GRE/GMAT, TOEFL/IELTS fees and up to six application fees, plus mentorship
scholarships.cycle: Applications usually open in June for that year's graduate application cycle
scholarships.summary: Support for recent graduates and final-year students from developing countries applying to graduate school abroad. It funds the tests and applications rather than tuition, and pairs each scholar with a mentor.

databases.name: Scholarships.com
databases.note: Large searchable database; filter by level, field and citizenship.

databases.name: Opportunity Desk
databases.note: Daily listings of scholarships, fellowships and conferences for African students.

databases.name: Studyportals Scholarships
databases.note: Search by destination country and degree level.

databases.name: NAFSA International Student Funding
databases.note: Guidance for students targeting the United States, including funding sources.

advice: Apply to funding and to the university separately; an admission offer is usually needed before a scholarship can be confirmed.
Check whether the award covers international fees, flights and dependants, not only tuition.
Use one reusable personal statement, then rewrite the opening paragraph for each award.
Keep certified transcripts, a passport scan, two reference letters and test scores ready before deadlines.
